tasks.title: Add barrel exports for feature modules
notes:
2026-02-14 18:02:22 UTC: Create index.ts files for each feature module to simplify imports and establish public APIs.

**Scope:**
- src/features/animation/index.ts
- src/features/gallery/index.ts
- src/core/index.ts
- src/shared/index.ts

**Benefits:**
- Simplified imports (`import { Editor } from '@/features/animation'` vs `from '@/features/animation/components/Editor'`)
- Clear public API boundaries
- Easier refactoring (internal changes don't break external imports)
- Better tree-shaking support

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Create src/features/animation/index.ts with public API exports (Editor, ReplayViewer, Canvas components, hooks, services)
- [ ] Create src/features/gallery/index.ts with public API exports (AnimationCard, PublicAnimationCard, SkeletonCard)
- [ ] Create src/core/index.ts for core utilities (projectStore, uiStore, common types)
- [ ] Create src/shared/index.ts for shared components
- [ ] Update key imports to use barrel exports (app pages, tests)
- [ ] Document export patterns in code comments
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes (npx tsc --noEmit)
- [ ] All tests pass (npm test)

**Related:** T003 (Feature-Based Architecture)
[COMPLETED 2026-02-14T18:08:00Z] Barrel exports created for all feature modules. TypeScript passes, no new test failures. Commit: da3cf0e
